# critic-adversarial — wave-46-asks-nothing, the whole run

Scope: how the pieces interact. Each piece was read as it landed; this reads the contracts one piece changed and another still assumes.

## Findings

1. **The starter yields to the rows it should precede.** T13's start returns while any row is ready (hooks/poker/tick.sh:2205, `case "${SCHED_READY_ALL:-}" in *[!\ ]*) return 0`). The verify and review rows read `approval:plan, head` by default at task scale and have no reads column to add `proof:regression` to (A-orch.3, A-orch.24, A-orch.26). So at the last build landing the walk and the critic are ready and the pass does not start. Observed in this run twice. At T15's landing the tick printed `FILL T17 T18` and started nothing, and the orchestrator typed the run by hand (A-orch.25). After T25 the walk was dispatched before any pass: T17's `ev=walk … discharged=3` is at 04:01:19Z (landing-proofs.log), and the tick's object `regression@837ddc39` appears at 04:05:11Z (.bionic/tmp/roster-a9d1c095-….state:16), once nothing was ready. This critic reads a head no pass ran at, against steps/6.md:21. Workaround: the orchestrator types `regression-run` at the last landing, as D5 allows. Not a wrong result, so S3. The person meets it as a longer run, or as a reviewed head that a red pass later changes.

2. **Step 7 is held to the merge rule.** facts_state's unproved arm (payload/scripts/lib/proof.sh:2407) serves every caller. `cur7_judge` asks it at Step 7 as well as Step 8 (hooks/poker/judge.sh:130, :283). D14 and AC-7.2 name Step 8 only. A-T10.1 and A-orch.17 log this as a question for the person, so it is logged, not silent. The interaction no single piece shows has two parts.
   - **The exit cannot be taken.** The refusal's person exit reads `needs: the user — reply <n> on the release card …`, and `<n>` stays literal while no card at that head holds the decision (proof.sh:1805). At Step 6 to 7 no release card can be at that head, because the card follows the Step-7 release row (steps/6.md:21). The only exit is the pass.
   - **Every close needs two whole passes.** One pass is needed at the Step-7 entry head. The release row T19 then lands a commit, `proof_whole_text` reads red again, and the card asks the merge without a pass unless a second pass runs at the release head. In this run that is two passes of about 30 minutes each (A-orch.25 to A-orch.27 give the first one's length), or the person's word once.

3. **The card asks a question its reply refuses.** The card draws `approve:merge-unproved` from `proof_merge_unproved` alone (hooks/poker/plan.sh:3105), with no integrate-row test. The approve verb admits `merge-unproved` only where `units_approval_names` prints `release` for an open integrate row (T23, A-T23.1). Otherwise it refuses at hooks/poker/proof.sh:525: "no row … reads approval:merge-unproved, so recording it would satisfy nothing". This is pinned at release-approval UA-3/UA-3b, re-executed green: .bionic/docs/record/wave-46-asks-nothing/T18-release-approval.log. A-T10.11 records it. On such a plan the person is offered `merge` and then refused, and the judge's own exit line names that same reply. Workaround: wait for the pass, which is the card's recommendation. So S3.

4. **The skill text contradicts the shipped rule.** skills/canonical-sdlc/operational-rules.md:75 still reads: "`regression-run` refuses it … on a proved head … a red is a fix row's, never a second run, and nothing waives it". steps/5.md:11 reads: "green, the head is accepted, with no second run". D16 removed the proved-head refusal (only hooks/poker/proof.sh:1791's same-head rule remains), D4 makes a second pass at the release head the normal path, and D14 lets the person's word stand in for it. The orchestrator acted on the old text here: A-orch.27 says "no second whole run is owed" and dispatched the reviewers on the covered head. Neither file is in the reviewed diff, and T19's Files name only the ADR and CHANGELOG. By the in-diff stop rule this is a next-wave item. It stays S3 because the person meets its consequence in the merge ask.

5. **The waiting-on-you line does not read the rounds.** T12 keeps every round of a re-put key (A-T12.6). `sitrep_waiting` folds register lines into arrays keyed by key, so the last line wins (hooks/poker/sitrep.sh:987, `$1 == "R" { rs[$2] = $3; … }`). The sheet's waste line counts only the newest round of a re-put key. The spec's own Risks line says "both read through one function, which is where the rule lands", and A-orch.13 leaves it for this review. The reader is older than the reviewed range (`git diff b69ac4a3c..837ddc391 -- hooks/poker/sitrep.sh | grep -c 'rs\[\$2\]'` → 0), and before T12 a re-put replaced the line, so the count is not worse than at the base. It is a next-wave item under the in-diff rule, rated S3 on: a non-core line of the person's sheet under-counts.

6. **A dead constant.** `SCORECARD_STOP_GAP=600` (hooks/session-poker.sh:3107) has no reader: `/usr/bin/grep -rn SCORECARD_STOP_GAP hooks payload/scripts tests` prints only that line. The constant is older than the reviewed range (added at ecc72d7d3) and was made dead by T12 (A-orch.13).

7. **A duplicate roster row.** The state file holds two byte-identical `status=run … name=regression@837ddc39 … launched_at=2026-10-26T04:05:11Z` rows (.bionic/tmp/roster-a9d1c095-….state lines 16-17). One booked process runs (pid 21284), so no second pass started. The cause is unverified. A read-then-append race between two ticks in the same second, past the object guard at tick.sh:2221-2228, would produce it. Both rows also carry `plan=` empty although the code passes `plan="$plan"`. Unverified why. No reader was seen to misread either.

8. **The walk record the wave requires is the one the walk gate refuses** (lead from the orchestrator, checked). T11's registration needs the critic's shape: `walk_register` refuses a record without a `| AC | verdict | why |` table (hooks/poker/proof.sh:212), and every row of that table names a criterion. The walk gate refuses any walk artifact holding `AC-<digit>` (payload/scripts/lib/walls.sh:4462-4466, `grep -qE 'AC-[0-9]' "$abs"`). It runs once a row is discharged and `walk-artifact:` is set, "re-checks at every later step", and its fix tells the writer to drop the ids. This run's registered record has 27 matches, and its table header is at walk.md:156. Saved output: .bionic/tmp/scratch/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003/w46-T18/walk-gate.log.
   - **Origin and pin.** The arm is older than the reviewed range (88bbcd8d4, 2026-09-12; `git diff b69ac4a3c..837ddc391 -- payload/scripts/lib/walls.sh | grep -c 'AC-\[0-9\]'` → 0). It meets T11's new contract, so the finding is sited on the change. Its `[WALL: tests/canonical-sdlc-evidence-gate.test.sh]` tag names a suite that no longer pins it: `/usr/bin/grep -rln "names acceptance criteria" tests/` prints nothing. No suite drives `current 5` over a record of D13's shape: session-poker-4 §WALK drives `deliver` and `proof-add walk` only. So nothing went red.
   - **Unverified.** I did not run the `current 5` refusal the orchestrator reports; it is not in my brief. The arm is unconditional once the match holds.
   - **Why S2 on.** Step 5 cannot be entered, which is core to the run. Every way past it needs the person or breaks the record: `walk: exempt` is the person's Step-0 word, and stripping the ids from walk.md unmakes the table the registration read and the matrix cites as evidence. The person meets it as a stop, which is a needs-you against AC-4.1's total of zero.
   - **Fix.** The fix is a choice between the arm (exempt a registered walk record's verdict table) and the walk shape (a table keyed some other way). That choice is the orchestrator's.

## Falsification attempts that failed
- **Dangling callers of the removed refusal.** `/usr/bin/grep -rn proof_whole_run_behind hooks payload/scripts tests` prints nothing, and the same-head refusal stands at hooks/poker/proof.sh:1791. D16 is whole.
- **The integrate row ready on the floor's covered while Step 8 refuses.** The integrate row reads `proof:review`, which is met only when facts_state answers `covered` as a whole (payload/scripts/lib/units.sh:1744), and facts_state's regression fact is `unproved` past F with no word. So T20 waits on the pass or the word, as D4 wants.
- **The AC-9.3 evidence-only matrix-set breaking total=0.** The fold counts `ev=matrix-set` only when its cells name status or task (hooks/poker/line.sh:739). The run's one such line is `cells=evidence` (landing-proofs.log), so it stays out of the count.
- **The tick-started run counted as a hand-hold.** second-regressions counts a run line past the first only at `starter=person` (hooks/poker/line.sh:735). Every run line in this record says `starter=orchestrator` or is the tick's.
- **The cap counting regression-born rows.** `_units_born_scan` matches `born: review S<n>` only (payload/scripts/lib/units.sh:3392), and task-add says a regression-born row "counts against no fix-cap" (hooks/poker/plan.sh:1353). T25 to T28 leave the cap untouched.
- **A changed test library run by suites that never ran past 402980ec.** rehearsal.test.sh and rehearsal-stop-rule.test.sh drive `clean` and `stop-rule` (tests/lib/rehearsal.sh:455-460), which never reach `_rh_reply` or `_rh_replay`.

## Untrusted input, permissions, failure direction
No new path takes untrusted input past the existing walls. `regression-run --reason` refuses `|` and line breaks (A-T8.2). The walk's `head:` line is held to the working branch's history (A-T11.2). `_refuse_log_need` fails silent and writes only to the bound plan's record (A-T3.1). Unknown answers in the judge and the printer go red or uncovered, never green (payload/scripts/lib/proof.sh:1705, :1743).
